title: New to this sub, but has anyone had the store dream?
content: Sorry if this is too basic and common. I've had it twice. One of them is more recent but much more fuzzy. In the original one, I am roaming around endlessly looking for something. All the items are just sort of randomly placed on the shelves; for instance, dog food next to makeup items, etc. At one point, I notice there's a deer in the store. It runs outside, and I look out the window to see it running around in the parking lot before it gets run over by a large truck. No clue what that's about.
